decisionRationale: Weighted 4.63 is below the 4.70 threshold; the score is not rounded up. Every category clears the 4.25 floor, all three director signatures and the delegated owner decision are present and honest, there is no lock violation, and no critical or high defect is open. This is therefore a quality-margin revise on a governance-sound packet, not a rejection. The gap is concentrated in three places: one verified stale present-tense claim inside a just-patched governing document (CG-JUDGE-001), the openly unestablished dual-route premise on which the chapter's agency proposition depends (CG-JUDGE-003), and the thinnest causal joint, Terra's in-chapter opposition (CG-JUDGE-005). I make no repair here and route all findings for independent re-review; the geometry pass-2 stream is credited with nothing (CG-JUDGE-006).
